An '''autojuke''' was an object that played [[Music/Legends|music]]. The [[Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill]] on [[StarForge Station]] had an autojuke that was playing [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] music when a group of [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] from the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' visited the establishment several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="PW" />
